compression: Managed archive 4.3 GZipEncoderWeb/GZipDecoderWeb with CRC verification; on-disk gzip framing and schema unchanged.

scope.purpose: Independent final 20,000-conversation insertion-order/mixed-field AOT regression gate after managed-gzip memory fix; not the 2M acceptance run.
scope.runtime: AOT Dart, production encrypted SQLite search, same frozen binary for both fixtures.
scope.environment: Shared development machine; parent full-suite/release validation could overlap. No CPU isolation or competing large-corpus producer.
scope.memory: Probe retains full synthetic conversations and exhaustive in-memory reference. Process peak RSS is diagnostic, not product working-memory or 2M capacity proof.
scope.timing: Each prepared query follows a fresh worker open and explicit prepare outside query timing. Its immediately repeated query is warm. Startup is reported separately.
scope.percentiles: Three samples per query/order/stage. Nearest-rank empirical p95 therefore equals the observed maximum; descriptive only, not a statistical estimate of production p95.
scope.correctness: All 120 returned ordered ID lists matched exhaustive SearchService top 100. Both fixture golden maps exactly match prior native-v6. Mixed project queries additionally assert all 100 winners contain Project in title.
scope.isolation: Only newly created synthetic /tmp databases opened. Actual large-corpus databases and binaries untouched.
scope.comparison: Native-v6 baseline uses identical ranking/schema/fixture but native gzip and different shared-machine load. Comparisons are observational, not controlled speedup measurements.
scope.limit: All measured 20k cases pass 500 ms; no claim about 2M latency, universal queries, or the 2GB product limit.

insertionOrders: Dart Random(42) shuffle of identical conversations
fixture.mixed: Project is present in every body and in exactly 200 titles (1%). Adds project and project grocery queries; keeps every transcript at 200 words.
fixture.goldens: Computed once per fixture, shared by chronological/shuffled runs and all samples, and retained in each raw report.
